name: dbt-coco-accelerator
description: Accelerate dbt analytics-engineering work from Jira, Linear, or Azure DevOps tickets inside Snowflake Cortex Code. Includes a one-time setup skill that installs the required MCP servers (dbt + your ticket tool), authenticates GitHub, and configures the accelerator to your workflow. Community project — not an official Snowflake, dbt, Atlassian, Linear, or Microsoft product.
